description.short: A conversational, one-question-at-a-time form for SharePoint lists.
description.full: Opens a one-question-at-a-time form in Microsoft 365 Copilot that adds an item to a SharePoint list. Copilot can prefill answers from the conversation; you review every answer and press Submit yourself. Supports text, multi-line text, choice, multi-choice, date, date-and-time, Yes/No, number, currency and hyperlink (URL format) columns.
